description.en: Backend (Maven) + frontend (Vite) build, lint, and tests — blocks release on failures

config.label: Explain the result
config.command: Summarize backend {{ step_0_output }}, frontend build {{ step_1_output }} and lint {{ step_2_output }}. Keep technical results unchanged; no gate markers of your own.

config.label: Gate-Verdict
config.command:
# Check whether the result contains RED
PREV={{ previous_output }}

if echo "$PREV" | grep -qi 'gate_status: RED'; then
  echo 'Build Gate: FAILED'
  echo 'gate_status: RED'
  echo 'gate_category: mysuricates-build'
  echo 'gate_description: MySuricates Build Gate failed'
elif echo "$PREV" | grep -qi 'gate_status: GREEN'; then
  echo 'Build Gate: PASSED'
  echo 'gate_status: GREEN'
  echo 'gate_category: mysuricates-build'
  echo 'gate_description: MySuricates Build Gate passed'
else
  echo 'Build Gate: INCOMPLETE'
  echo 'gate_status: YELLOW'
  echo 'gate_category: mysuricates-build'
  echo 'gate_description: Result incomplete — no gate status in the report (AI block failed or unclear)'
fi
